decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - 1/  The proposed height, bulk, massing and design of the proposal would be detrimental to the appearance of the house and the amenities and outlook of adjoining properties.  This would be contrary to Policies ENV.1.1,  ENV.4.11 and H.3.4 of the Adopted Unitary Development Plan (1996) and Policies ENV-B.1.1,  ENV-N.1.7  and H.6.4 of the  Revised Deposit Unitary Development Plan (2001) and Supplementary Planning Guidance, House Extension Guidelines.


2/  The proposed  extensions, would, by reason of  their size, position and 
appearance  in relation to  the surrounding park and residential area, be 
unduly obtrusive  and would not serve to preserve or enhance the character of     
properties, the street scene and the setting of the Metropolitan Open Land and    
the Historic Park and  the Gunnersbury Park Conservation Area  and is 
contrary to the Policies ENV1.2 of the Unitary Development Plan and ENVB 
2.2 of the Revised Deposit Unitary Development Plan and Supplementary 
Planning Guidance, Conservation Areas.
description: Erection of a roof extension, first floor side extension, and 2 storey rear extension to dwellinghouse
